name: Imperial Hotel Tokyo — Toko-an Tea Room (Hibiya)
editor_note: A tea room inside the Imperial Hotel, bookable online. The base plan is tea and sweets in about 30 minutes; pick the longer plan if you want to whisk a bowl yourself.
price_note: ¥5,000 tea and sweets (about 30 min) / ¥8,000 with matcha-making (about 60 min), tax and service included, from the official page, read 2026-11-03.
notes: 4F Main Building. Tatami seating. 10:00-16:00, closed Sundays and public holidays. Sometimes fully booked for private functions.
